description: This file contains unit tests for the DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor class in the Goteo project, specifically testing its functionality related to matching duplicate investments in the context of the application.

classes.name: DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed to test the DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor's behavior and functionalities within the Goteo application.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation and validation of the Matcher instance.

methods.name: testAddUsers
methods.description: Tests adding users to the matcher and related database updates.

methods.name: testAddProjects
methods.description: Tests associating a project with the matcher.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor class.

methods.name: testId
methods.description: Verifies the ID and recognition methods of the processor.

methods.name: testName
methods.description: Verifies the name and description of the processor.

methods.name: testVars
methods.description: Checks the retrieval and setting of default variables for the processor.

methods.name: testUserAmounts
methods.description: Tests calculation of user-specific investment amounts based on a total.

methods.name: testMatchFactor
methods.description: Tests the influence of the match factor on the amount calculation.

methods.name: testAmount
methods.description: Tests calculation of the amount to invest, including edge cases with drops and invest limits.

methods.name: testAmountReward
methods.description: Tests handling of rewards in amount calculations.

methods.name: testInvests
methods.description: Checks retrieval, storage, and correctness of multiple investments.

methods.name: testInvestsRepeat
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the maximum number of investments per user is reached.

methods.name: testNoFunds
methods.description: Simulates exhaustion of available funds in the matcher and checks error handling.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes test data and confirms cleanup.

methods.name: testCleanUsers
methods.description: Cleans up test users and related data from the database.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all tests in the class have been run.
